title: The_Nether_goes_dutch
description:
Nether ❌
Netherlands ✔️
this texture pack makes the nether in to the Netherlands
body:
The Nether? Nope — Welcome to the Netherlands.
This resource pack transforms the Nether into the Netherlands. Most Nether blocks and mobs are now fully themed with the Dutch flag!

- Block Changes:

1. Netherrack

2. Nether Bricks and all their variants

3. Netherite Block

  All have been retextured with the Netherlands flag colors — red, white, and blue!

- Item & Equipment Changes:
Netherite Armor & Tools are now full Netherland gear

Blaze Rod and Blaze Powder / The Nether Star

 Mob Retextures:
The Ghast now displays a huge Netherlands flag

The Blaze has also been retextured to match the theme.
